title: Residents Harmed by Oil Drilling May Soon Receive Reparations Under New California Law
summary: The money would come from the state’s community repair and reinvestment fund for people living nearest the oil field. That law requires the Inglewood Oil Field to close by 2030 and establish a penalty structure for low-producing wells.
